data.title: 丛雨 · 浅溪接住一片红叶
data.description: 山溪从扁石旁拐弯，一片红叶被水推到了石缝。丛雨在及踝的清水里蹲下，把木碗放平，让叶子顺着水流漂进去。红白连体泳裙的绳结整整齐齐，袖边缀着的轻纱随她抬碗轻轻一颤。
data.location: 穗织神社后山的浅石溪
data.action: 蹲在浅水中，用平放的木碗接住顺流的红叶
data.lighting: 林隙的阳光在浅溪和碗口间跳动
data.camera: 平视侧面全身，留出石缝和水流
data.promptProse: Murasame crouches at the edge of ankle-deep creek water, holding a shallow wooden bowl flat so a red leaf floats into it. Her opaque white and crimson shrine-maiden swimdress has tiny paper tassels at the waist cord and light ruffles at the shoulders. Sunlight breaks into little spots over the stones.
data.animaCaption: She steadies the bowl with both hands until the current carries the red leaf over the rim.
